[SWS_DM_01745] Behavior on failed transport protocol initialization
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04168
⌈
If a
apext::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolHandler::
Initialize
returns
kInitializeFailed
, the DM shall stop the initialization
process of the transport protocol and call no further methods on that
apext::diag::
uds_transport::UdsTransportProtocolHandler
.
